title: remote-fixture-control
responsibility: Owns the remote-fixture-control build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: remoteFixtureControl.port
inputs.description: Port passed to `server.listen` for the control listener, which binds to `127.0.0.1`; `0` lets the OS choose a port. It must be a valid TCP port, and the selected port is used in the returned origin.

inputs.name: remoteFixtureControl.actions
inputs.description: A map whose keys are exact `METHOD /path` request strings such as `GET /fixture`, and whose values are `FixtureAction` callbacks. Each callback receives the parsed request body as a record, and its result is awaited and serialized as JSON; unmatched keys receive a 404 response.

outputs.name: remoteFixtureControl
outputs.description: This is the handle resolved after the listener binds, with `origin` set to its loopback URL and `close` providing asynchronous shutdown. The close callback closes all active connections first and resolves after `server.close` completes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A synchronous exception raised while creating or starting the server rejects the returned promise, so no handle is produced. Request parsing, fixture-action, and oversized-body errors are caught by the request handler and returned as HTTP 409 JSON instead.
